summary: Investigated a reported breakage of the git extension's stage/unstage/commit operations. Traced the code path from the web UI's ChangesPanel through the agent-server's extension host to the registry git package's GitService, inspected existing files (ChangesPanel.svelte, git-service.ts, git-extension.ts, host.ts, pi-extension.ts, server.ts), confirmed the agent server is running on 127.0.0.1:8787, and located the WebSocket request/response schema in preparation for reproducing the failure with a test client.
errors: Bash command `ls /c/Users/mchan/projects/gizmo/packages/git` exited with code 2 because the git package is not present in the workspace; it lives only in the gizmo-registry under ~/.gizmo/registries/gizmo-registry/packages/git.
